comment: Single source of truth for the file extensions treated as media. src/scraper.rs (is_media_url, is_playlist_url) and extension/media-scan.js (MEDIA_EXTENSIONS) each keep their own literal, and both test suites assert against this file, so the two cannot drift without failing. Matching is a case-insensitive substring test on the whole URL, not a suffix test, because query strings and CDN path segments routinely follow the extension. See docs/adr/0011-one-playlist-parser.md.
